claims.claim: Stress testing asks how a budget behaves when assumptions change. Construct plausible scenarios rather than predicting one future: lower income, higher essential costs, or a one-off expense. Calculate the new surplus, identify which obligations are fixed, and consider safe options such as support or a revised plan. A financial buffer can absorb some shocks, but it is finite. Use scenarios to reveal fragility, not to prescribe investment or debt decisions.
